exposure: management strategy for vasa previa (outpatient vs. inpatient)
Management strategy (elective admission at 34 weeks gestation vs outpatient management)
Management strategy for vasa previa (outpatient vs inpatient)
cohort: 109 women with prenatally diagnosed vasa previa between January 2007 and June 2017 at a single tertiary center
finding: Women with vasa previa who were electively admitted at 34 weeks gestation had a higher rate of antenatal steroid exposure and a lower rate of urgent cesarean section compared to those managed as outpatients, but there was no difference in neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study compared pregnancy outcomes between two management strategies for vasa previa: elective admission at 34 weeks gestation and outpatient management.
